title: Engineering the NAMC National Event Portal
summaryLead: The digital home for a national conference: tickets, sponsors, schedule and passes.
summaryMore: A static-first build on Netlify, with serverless forms and calendar sync.

stack.name: Architecture
stack.detail: Static-first and composable, with no server rendering or database.

stack.name: Accessibility
stack.detail: Structured to WCAG 2.1 AA, with keyboard and screen-reader support.

stack.name: Styling
stack.detail: Modern CSS with Grid, fluid type and design tokens.

stack.name: Calendar sync
stack.detail: Generated .ics files for Apple, Google and Outlook.

stack.name: Sponsor workflow
stack.detail: Serverless form endpoints validate uploads and notify the admin team.

chapters.title: Fast under conference traffic
chapters.challenge: Serve updates, agenda and sponsors quickly during peak announcements.
chapters.solution: Pre-built static pages served from the edge.
chapters.outcome: Pages stay quick when traffic spikes.

chapters.title: Sponsor onboarding
chapters.challenge: Let sponsors pick a tier and upload vector logos without admin back-and-forth.
chapters.solution: Serverless form endpoints validate files and route notifications.
chapters.outcome: A short sign-up flow with automatic hand-off.

chapters.title: Schedule and calendar sync
chapters.challenge: Give attendees a scannable schedule they can add to any calendar.
chapters.solution: A CSS Grid agenda plus generated .ics files.
chapters.outcome: One tap adds a session or a whole track.

results.title: Speed
results.text: Static pages from the edge, with no database to wait on.

results.title: Less admin
results.text: Sponsor sign-up and notifications are automated.
